# Ryan Duguid

> Ryan Duguid is a Senior Accountant in Newcastle, NSW, Australia, a Provisional CA ANZ Member, a Bachelor of Commerce (Accounting) graduate of the University of Newcastle, SAP S/4HANA certified in Financial Accounting (FI) and Management Accounting (CO) and a Xero Certified Specialist, Level 3. He builds open source Australian computational accounting tools: 76 browser tax and business calculators, 12 ATO rate tables, 7,430 depreciation effective lives, native Excel LAMBDA functions (Ozzit), month-end review pipelines, a local MCP server (Aus Accounting MCP) and AI agent workflows. Public examples use fabricated data.

This file indexes the GitHub repositories; links to package folders point to their raw README files. The canonical, more detailed index of the website and its tools is https://duguid.com.au/llms.txt. Version numbers and counts change with each release; read them from the linked repository or release page.

- Location: Newcastle, NSW, Australia. Jurisdiction: Commonwealth of Australia (ATO, AASB, IFRS, TPB).
- Credentials: Bachelor of Commerce (Accounting), University of Newcastle. Provisional CA ANZ Member. SAP S/4HANA certified in Financial Accounting (FI) and Management Accounting (CO). Xero Certified Specialist, Level 3, awarded 1 July 2026 and valid until 1 July 2027 (certificate: https://duguid.com.au/evidence/#xero-certification).
- Contact: ryan@duguid.com.au or https://duguid.com.au/contact/. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryan-duguid/.

## Start here

- [Tools on the website](https://duguid.com.au/tools/): browser tools and fictional worked examples, with nothing to install.
- [76 browser tax and business calculators](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/): 57 business, 17 individual tax and 2 standalone Australian calculators, all with WebMCP support.
- [Profit and cash worked example](https://duguid.com.au/examples/profit-vs-cash-flow/): a fictional Newcastle business where delaying one $44,000 receipt by 45 days leaves quarterly profit at $35,957.55 whilst daily cash falls to minus $25,160 on 6 November 2026.
- [Monthly Close Controls worked example](https://duguid.com.au/tools/monthly-close-controls/#worked-example): 8 exceptions in a fictional July close, including a $250 creditors difference.
- [Evaluations](https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/): reproducible synthetic evaluations.
- [Evidence](https://duguid.com.au/evidence/): credentials, releases and accepted upstream work.

## Repositories

- [Ozzit](https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit): native Excel LAMBDA functions and help tables for GST arithmetic and financial modelling, including financial-year labels, depreciation and AASB 16 lessee schedules. No macros or add-ins; needs Microsoft 365 or Excel 2024 or later. Overview: https://duguid.com.au/tools/ozzit/.
- [australian-accounting](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting): local calculation engines for ATO small business benchmarks, Payday Super timing and Division 7A loan review, available through the aus-accounting-mcp server.
- [aus-accounting-mcp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/main/apps/aus-accounting-mcp/README.md): local MCP server over stdio for those engines and a set of tax and super worksheets. Install with `uvx aus-accounting-mcp`. Registry name: io.github.ryanduguid/aus-accounting. Unsupported Division 7A matters are refused, and it ships no ATO document library. The MCP host still sends tool arguments and results to its model provider.
- [australian-accounting-skills](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills): preparation and review workflows for public practice and contracting, including BAS, month-end close, payroll, workpaper tie-outs and the former Hardhat Ledger subcontractor workflows (there is no separate Hardhat pack). Claude Code plugin, Codex plugin or portable skill files; `npx skills add ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills` installs from the default branch.
- [accounting-review-pipeline](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline): month-end close checks on Xero trial balance exports, producing exception packs for human sign-off, with Excel and Power BI components.
- [OzFPA](https://github.com/ryanduguid/OzFPA): Australian extension of openfpa by Jeff Brines and Guiderail, with 30 June years, Xero AU and GST. Holds the source for the profit and cash example.
- [DrDebits](https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits): APES 110 and TPB Code controls, refusal patterns and evaluation fixtures for firms using LLMs in tax work. Conclusions stay with the registered practitioner.
- [PaulGoodman](https://github.com/ryanduguid/PaulGoodman): builds a retrieval corpus from in-force Commonwealth tax legislation on the Federal Register of Legislation, with source and provenance records. It is a finding aid, not authorised legislation.

## Reuse

- [Reusing this material](https://github.com/ryanduguid/ryanduguid/blob/main/AGENTS.md#reusing-this-code): Ryan Duguid's work under CC BY 4.0; sharing it requires credit, the licence or a link to it and a note of any changes made.

## Boundary

- Ryan Duguid is not a registered tax agent or BAS agent. The repositories are free software, not a practice, and do not take advice, return preparation, tax-treatment confirmation or lodgement requests.
- Support covers software issues reproduced with fabricated data. Do not send taxpayer information, client files or credentials.
- The tools prepare and review work. They do not lodge, post to ledgers, make payments, approve files or lock periods; those stay with an accountable human.

## Optional

- [payday-super-checker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/main/packages/payday-super-checker/README.md): Payday Super contribution timelines and experimental SG charge exposure. Not an ATO assessment.
- [ato-benchmark-compare](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/main/packages/ato-benchmark-compare/README.md): offline profit and loss comparison against ATO small business benchmarks.
- [TheExchequerTally](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/main/packages/the-exchequer-tally/README.md): company tax rate from operator-established facts (base rate entity test, s 23AA ITRA 1986), franking account balance and Division 203.
- [SolomonsSword](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/main/packages/solomons-sword/README.md): trust income allocation under Division 6 ITAA 1936, s 100A and s 99B.
- [xero-trial-balance-export](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/main/packages/xero-trial-balance-export/README.md): Xero trial balance exporter; movement and year to date must both tie before a CSV is written.
- [Monthly Close Controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/main/packages/monthly-close-control-plane/README.md): local trial balance review packs with exception surfacing (distribution `monthly-close-control-plane`). It does not approve or lock a close.
- [Workpaper Review Gate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/main/packages/review-ready-gate/README.md): checks whether a BAS, month-end or year-end pack is ready for manager review (distribution `review-ready-gate`, command `review-ready`). READY is not sign-off.
- [Xero Ledger Review Gate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/main/packages/elizabeth-anne-alexander/README.md): synthetic demonstration of a fixed-policy trial balance review boundary (distribution and command `elizabeth-anne-alexander`).
- [accounting-excel-toolkit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/main/adapters/accounting-excel-toolkit/README.md): Power Query (M) and VBA automation for Australian month-end reporting.
- [Australian Accounting Power BI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/main/apps/australian-accounting-power-bi/README.md): source-controlled Power BI project for accounting analytics, consolidation, ATO benchmarks and Payday Super review.
- [Related resources](https://duguid.com.au/tools/#related-resources): third-party libraries, ATO guidance and legislation sources, kept on the website.
- [Contribution forks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ryanduguid/ryanduguid/main/FORKS.md): forks kept for upstream contributions, with their open, merged and closed upstream pull requests.
